messages:
kim: Heads-up: ops reported a customer with a long streaming session where tokens vanished from provisional then reappeared as confirmed but split across two model versions (gpt-lite-v1 and gpt-proto-v2). Billing shows two charges. Anyone seen model-swap + reconnect causing split charges?
rahul: That sounds like resume+model-swap edge. When router reroutes to a different model variant mid-session we sometimes issue a new session id and runtime may truncate last N tokens before resuming. Ledger treats them as distinct.
sylvie: I pulled a trace: initial session st-aa11 on gpt-lite-v1 produced 420 tokens, client reconnected at offset 410. Router forwarded resume to rtr-3 but due to capacity swapped to gpt-proto-v2 and created new session st-bb22. Runtime accepted resume_offset=410 but emitted only 400 tokens (truncated). Then runtime produced additional 60 tokens on new session. Ledger saw confirmed 400 under st-bb22 and left provisional 10 from st-aa11, later reconciling them as separate charges.

sylvie: Trace snippet: ```json
{"session":"st-aa11","model":"gpt-lite-v1","tokens":420}
{"resume":{"from":"st-aa11","to":"st-bb22","resume_offset":410}}
{"session":"st-bb22","model":"gpt-proto-v2","tokens":460}
```
maria: Problem: join key only session_id. Proposal: billing join on (parent_session_id, offset_range) when resume header present and require model-tag in metric for debugging.
rahul: Also need to decide truncation semantics. If runtime truncates at resume, we must attribute truncated overlap to parent_session and not double-charge. Option: billing checks for (parent_session, offset_range) overlap and mark overlapping tokens as deduped if model_compat flag true.
kim: UX: customer sees "split across models" line items. We should show model per-line and mark "model-switch during resume" with link to docs. Also show provisional vs final in timeline.

sylvie: Quick SQL to find suspects: ```sql
select parent_session, count(distinct session) as sessions, sum(tokens) as tokens
from streaming_events
where event_time > now() - interval '30 days'
and resume_header is not null
group by parent_session
having count(distinct session) > 1
order by tokens desc
limit 50;
```
maria: Short-term mitigation: when resume_header present, make ledger keep provisional tokens for 3m and hold final confirmation until a final ACK from runtime that includes model_id and final_token_count. That buys time for reconciliation.
rahul: Implementation tasks: 1) router: set X-Parent-Session + X-Resume-Model when re-routing with model swap; 2) runtime: include final_ack with model_id and final_token_count; 3) billing: add join on parent_session+offset_range and a feature flag billing.resume_model_dedupe. Add metric billing.model_swap_dedupe.{true,false}.

kim: I'll write a short console note and add a debug CSV column "models_observed".
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-1303 'Model-swap resume duplicate/truncation accounting' assigned to rahul, priority P2.
sylvie: Tests: resume without model-swap, resume with compatible variant, resume with incompatible variant (should not dedupe), toolcall during resume, truncated overlap.
maria: Cool. Action items: rahul implement headers + billing change behind flag, sylvie add tests and search query to ops playbook, kim update console debug exports. We'll review in next platform sync.
rahul: Also adding an alert if billing.model_swap_dedupe true rate > 0.1% of streaming sessions to catch regressions.
kim: thanks all :shipit:
